claims.location: comment[data file] and assay name rows 1-9
claims.evidence: The PRIDE file list has exactly nine R0406 RAW archives. Deposited MaxQuant summary.txt links their full raw basenames to experiments S1 through S9.

claims.location: source name, characteristics[biological replicate], comment[technical replicate], characteristics[expression construct], factor value[expression construct] rows 1-9
claims.value: one GFP-PafA control, one AtRACK1a-PafA and one NbRACK1-PafA source, each split into three IP preparations
claims.evidence: PRIDE's sample processing protocol states that N. benthamiana extract supernatant was divided into three equal aliquots for independent immunoprecipitation triplicates. Each construct therefore has one source name, biological replicate 1 and technical IP replicates 1-3. The paper's vector methods establish GFP/AtRACK1a/NbRACK1-PafA fusion orientation. Supplementary Data 1 has separate 'AtRACK1a and GFP LFQ' and 'NbRACK1 and GFP LFQ' sheets sharing GFP_rep1-3 columns. Matching Protein IDs and log2 LFQ intensity against deposited R0406 proteinGroups.txt maps S1-3 to GFP_rep1-3, S4-6 to AtRACK_rep1-3, and S7-9 to NbRACK_rep1-3. Exact nonzero protein matches are 690, 682, 652, 898, 893, 882, 832, 855 and 848 respectively (absolute difference <0.0001); off-diagonal matches are at most two. The run map is in results/denmark/PXD048346_R0406_run_map.tsv.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], characteristics[organism part], characteristics[growth condition] rows 1-9
claims.value: Nicotiana benthamiana greenhouse-grown leaves collected two days after Agrobacterium infiltration
claims.evidence: The protein-expression methods specify Agrobacterium infiltration of PafA-GFP, AtRACK1a-PafA and NbRACK1-PafA constructs into N. benthamiana leaves, with tissue collected two days later from greenhouse-grown plants.

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[instrument], comment[cleavage agent details] rows 1-9
claims.value: timsTOF Pro PASEF DDA with physical trypsin digestion
claims.evidence: The paper's bead-elution LC-MS method specifies trypsin digestion and timsTOF Pro PASEF. R0406 summary.txt records all nine runs as TIMS-DDA. Its Trypsin/P designation is the MaxQuant search setting, not the digestion reagent.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance], comment[modification parameters] rows 1-9
claims.value: 10 ppm, 40 ppm, fixed carbamidomethyl C, variable oxidation M and protein N-terminal acetylation
claims.evidence: R0406 mqpar.xml gives 10 ppm main search tolerance; the TOF MS/MS parameter is 40 ppm. summary.txt confirms all three modifications for every run.

limitations: This SDRF covers the nine R0406 Nicotiana runs only. The same three GFP runs are controls for both published RACK1 comparisons and appear once in this SDRF.
The paper does not give plant developmental age for these leaves, so characteristics[developmental stage] is 'not available'.
The published rep1-rep3 labels denote independent immunoprecipitations of split extract, not distinct plants; the SDRF records one biological source and three technical preparations per construct.
The accession-wide PRIDE protocol also includes a distinct Q Exactive HF workflow; run-specific TIMS-DDA search output and the paper's timsTOF Pro PASEF method support this subset.
